facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map. Grimny says Bral probably hid it in the Dragon's Lair, a very small one-room cave the dwarves once scouted as a hiding place.
Dr. Uriah's Read Languages spell reveals the writing under one treasure-map location per day.
What is the one remaining unidentified location marked on the treasure map? Sir Phidipaldi guesses it is King Hogboon's, whose goblin castle in a ruined temple lies near an unmarked area of the map.
The dragon said to lair at the Dragon's Lair stands between the party and the treasure Bral likely hid there; Dunk suspects there is no dragon and Bral only pretends there is.
facts.uncertain_reason: Grimny describes the lair as a tiny empty cave and Dunk speculates the dragon is a ruse.
